list.empty: No members yet. Analyze a repository to see who's contributing.

ethics.title: About these metrics
ethics.body: This view measures the project's resilience and how knowledge is spread — not individual performance. It is not a leaderboard or a productivity tracker. Members can be anonymized or excluded on request.

health.single_maintainer_hint: Repositories with only one member — a bus-factor risk.
health.concentration_hint: Share of all commits by the single most active member. Higher means knowledge is concentrated.

exclusions.title: Member exclusions
exclusions.description: Hide bots or people who've asked not to be measured. A pattern matches a member's email or name (e.g. an exact address, or a glob like *[bot]*). Built-in bot filters always apply.
exclusions.empty: No custom exclusions. Built-in bot filters still apply.
